_comment: Editorial content for IMS. Every fact is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached. IMS is an operating brokerage and investment bank, not a fund or a Modaraba.
description: Intermarket Securities Limited is a SECP-licensed brokerage house and TREC holder of the Pakistan Stock Exchange, serving retail, institutional and global investors since 1994. It delivers brokerage, equity research and investment banking, and runs the IMTrade online trading platform as well as Roshan Digital Account services for overseas Pakistanis. It is the flagship of the Intermarket Group.
headOffice: 5th Floor, Trade Centre, I.I. Chundrigar Road, Karachi, Pakistan
